title: Syed Mustafa Ali vs Kamala Devi Bommireddy
nature: suit for injunction over boundary wall
one_line_summary: Neighbour claims the boundary wall at Mehdipatnam encroaches 3 feet into his plot.
court: Court of the IV Additional Chief Judge, City Civil Court, Hyderabad

hearings.order_sheet: Issues framed. For plaintiff's evidence, call on 02.07.2025.
hearings.note: Kamala Devi wall (OS 227/24) - issues framed, 4 issues. Main one: whether the wall encroaches 3 ft into plaintiff's plot. We should push for an advocate commissioner with a surveyor - our survey sketch from 2019 is strong.

action_items.task: draft I.A. for appointment of advocate commissioner with surveyor

hearings.outcome: I.A. for advocate commissioner filed; plaintiff sought time for evidence
hearings.order_sheet: I.A. No. 1320 of 2025 filed by defendant for appointment of advocate commissioner. Notice. Counsel for plaintiff seeks time to file chief-examination affidavit of PW1. Granted. Call on 20.08.2025.
hearings.note: Kamala Devi - filed our commissioner IA. Jadhav sought time for PW1 affidavit - 'client out of station'. 1st time from their side. Harsha (son) drove Kamala amma here, she sat in the corridor 3 hours. Must tell them she need not come unless I call.
hearings.client_interaction: Told Harsha his mother need not attend unless specifically told.
hearings.adjournment_reason: plaintiff out of station, chief affidavit not ready

hearings.order_sheet: I.A. No. 1320 of 2025 allowed. Sri K. Anand Kumar, Advocate, appointed as Advocate Commissioner to measure the boundary with the help of a licensed surveyor and file report. Plaintiff's evidence after report. Call on 29.10.2025.
hearings.note: Kamala Devi - commissioner IA allowed!! Anand Kumar appointed with surveyor. Jadhav objected loudly but judge said 'measurement will help both sides'. Coordinate with Anand Kumar for site visit date.

action_items.task: coordinate advocate commissioner site visit and deposit his fee

hearings.order_sheet: Report of Advocate Commissioner filed. Copies to both sides. Objections, if any, in two weeks. For plaintiff's evidence, call on 10.12.2025.
hearings.note: Kamala Devi - commissioner report filed. Wall is within our boundary except a 4 inch deviation at the rear corner. That is huge for us - plaintiff claimed 3 FEET. Jadhav will file objections.

hearings.outcome: Plaintiff sought time again for PW1 affidavit
hearings.order_sheet: Counsel for plaintiff seeks time to file chief-examination affidavit of PW1 and objections to the report. Granted. Call on 18.02.2026.
hearings.note: Kamala Devi - Jadhav again sought time, 'objections to commissioner report under preparation'. This is their 2nd adjournment before IV ACJ. Judge made a note. I said nothing, no need.
hearings.adjournment_reason: objections to commissioner's report under preparation

hearings.outcome: Third adjournment sought by plaintiff's counsel; granted with costs of Rs. 5,000
hearings.order_sheet: Counsel for plaintiff again seeks time to file chief-examination affidavit of PW1. This is the third request on behalf of the plaintiff. Granted subject to costs of Rs. 5,000/- payable to the defendant. Call on 24.06.2026.
hearings.note: Kamala Devi wall - Jadhav asked for time a 3rd time, said PW1 is travelling. IV ACJ imposed Rs 5000 costs, payable to Kamala amma. And he said orally, looking straight at Jadhav: "Third time is not a request, it is a strategy." Not in the order, only oral. Whole court went quiet. Harsha was thrilled.
hearings.client_interaction: Told Harsha the Rs. 5,000 costs will come to his mother; next time they must file PW1 affidavit.
hearings.adjournment_reason: PW1 travelling, chief affidavit not filed

hearings.outcome: PW1 chief-examination affidavit filed; costs paid
hearings.order_sheet: Costs paid. Chief-examination affidavit of PW1 filed. Exs. A1 to A5 marked. For cross-examination of PW1, call on 05.08.2026.
hearings.note: Kamala Devi - costs 5000 paid by cash receipt, given to Harsha. PW1 affidavit filed finally. His own sale deed (A1) gives the plot as 30 ft x 45 ft - commissioner measured 30 ft x 44 ft 8 in. So the 3 ft claim is nonsense. Prepare cross around A1 dimensions + commissioner report.

action_items.task: prepare cross-examination of PW1 around Ex.A1 dimensions and commissioner report

hearings.order_sheet: Presiding Officer on leave. Adjourned to 05.10.2026.
